about: Printing slips in a nasab: the full name stays exactly as printed on the person's page, and the nasab tree and the nasab quiz stop the line before the slipped name, so it joins no one wrongly. Keyed by the person's slug; `at` is the slipped name as printed; `note` says what the slip is and where that is known (the editor's note, another entry).

abd-al-rahman-ibn-samurah.note: Not a slip but a disputed link: the entry (Siyar 2/571) gives Hisham ibn al-Kalbi, Ibn Ma'in, al-Bukhari and Abu Ubayd's «ابن سمرة بن حبيب بن عبد شمس», and al-Zubayr ibn Bakkar and Mus'ab add «بن ربيعة» after Habib. The line stops at Habib so no meeting point is asked through the disputed link.

al-miswar-ibn-makhramah.note: Siyar v6 p390 prints «بن زهرة بن قصي بن كلاب». Zuhrah is the son of Kilab, not of Qusayy: the two are brothers, sons of Kilab, as the Prophet's ﷺ nasab and every Zuhri nasab in the Siyar give it. So «بن قصي» here is a printing slip.

abdullah-ibn-as-saib.note: Siyar v6 p388 prints «صيفي بن عابد بن عمر بن مخزوم», leaving out «عبد الله» between Abid and Umar: Abid is the son of Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Makhzum (al-Isti'ab; Tahdhib al-Kamal), the brother of Hilal (Abu Salamah's line, p406) and of Uthman (Amr ibn Hurayth's line, p417). His line stops at «عابد» so it does not meet them at «عمر».
